findings: HELD-OUT FAILURE, packet mechanism (outer notes, 5c6421973): BE no_outer_note_left_of_image (Java exit 0) DIFF 15 and no_outer_two_notes_on_image DIFF 23. Element structure is identical, but every x is +1 and svg width/height are +1. Cause: render_autonomous_composite takes the outer scope from layout_autonomous_scope, whose origin is the fixed SVEK_ORIGIN_X/SVEK_ORIGIN_Y (+1 only for a rectangle on top). 5c6421973 adds the note image to max_x/max_y but never re-derives the outer origin from painted bounds; normalize_autonomous_scope does that only for image regions. In Java, LimitFinder.drawRectangle (LimitFinder.java 175-177) adds (x-1, y-1), while the Opale note is a UPath, which drawUPath (155-157) adds without adjust. A leftmost note therefore moves Java's origin by 1 px. BB note_link_only_to_group passes only because a rectangle is leftmost there. Not a regression (base and round 3 also DIFF), but it is the account's own perturbation axis ('note left/right of an autarkic group at root, renamed').

HELD-OUT FAILURE, same mechanism family (note quark identity on the root cluster path): BE no_root_cluster_note DIFF 1 and no_root_two_clusters_notes DIFF 2. data-qualified-name is GMN2 where Java writes Hall.GMN2 (East.GMN2, West.GMN5); the remaining x drifts are below GEOM_EPS. The same value occurs in base and round 3 (pre-existing). 5c6421973 applies the declaring-group prefix (spec.id = parent.id) on the image path only, while render_non_autarkic_root_clusters keeps the bare id. The Java cause is the one the maker cites: CommandFactoryNoteOnEntity.executeInternal 258-260, quarkInContext as a child of the current group.

Paint order confirmed on held-out BE: 4 image-path cases, 1 outer-leaf case, and the 2 root-path cases in element order. BC nc_* 3/3. Versus round 3 the sweep changes 11 outputs (golden state_note_composite, the 3 BB pairs it targets, and 7 astra unicode_* outputs from the carrier width) with 0 lost matches.

Border points confirmed: BE 7/7 and BC 6/6 match, and the frontier invariant holds on 9/9 checker probes in the tip. Round 3 violates it on bp_wide_entry_with_note (circle at 69.72,137.4883 off every cluster border).

Graphviz stderr: the Java discard is confirmed (AbstractGraphviz.createFile3), and Rust has no consumer of Graphviz error state (grep agerrors|aglasterr: none). Versus round 3 the stderr lines lost are 170 'port P unrecognized', 1 'Unable to reclaim box space in spline routing', 3 'already in a rankset' and 1 'removing empty cluster'; the class.rs panic line is unchanged apart from its thread id. No source in any tree has a Graphviz 'Error:' line. Declared residue: a Rust-only DOT defect is now silent on stderr.

Outer layout size: note boxes count toward the outer size (disclosed). The right-side and on-leaf cases confirm it; the left-side cases fail on origin (finding 1). Rust-only probes: st_np_outer_note_left_multiline and np_outer_note_right_renamed change r3->tip (the former is predicted to carry finding 1); np_outer_note_top_of_image, np_outer_note_left_on_leaf_with_image and np_outer_floating_with_image are unchanged r3->tip (fall-through). Java references are staged in c4a.
